title: 16 虎兄无犬妹17 打死你这个j人
content_zh:
庶女的生存法则
其实，如情也很想骄傲地说是自己的杰作，但这样就会给人一种泼辣恶毒的印象，本想打死也不承认的。这下子可好，全被玲珑这笨丫头给揭了底了，她想扮柔弱都扮不起来了。不由泄气地瞪了她，这个成事不足，败事有余的丫头。
李骁的护卫一听是如情的杰作，纷纷狐疑又畏惧地望着如情，有些觉得如情一个弱质女流居然能对付两个凶残成性的靼鞑，有些不大相信，但也有人觉得如情不愧为方知义的妹妹，果真是虎兄无犬妹呀。
虎兄无犬妹？
李骁一听这话，笑得几乎岔了气。
如情不明所以，也只能傻笑着回应，“没办法嘛，我也不想这样的，事急从权嘛。”
李骁笑道：“怎么一副生怕别人知道你厉害的模样？”
如情心虚着，刚才与李骁做了人工呼吸，双方的护卫看他们的目光都好暖昧，好复杂，她只想赶紧离开这儿，与李骁离得远远的。
高高陡陡的一道斜坡，李骁等人虽然都身上带伤，但上去还算是轻易而举的，可就苦了如情了，早已透支了一身力气，这回子爬得可吃力了。
李骁身上也有伤的，不过都是些小伤，练武之人，对伤口早已习以为常，但见如情这般吃力，也看不过去，本想扶她一把，却被如情挡开，“多谢王爷好意，如情还能走的。”
李骁见她脸上，手肘上，脚踝上及全身上下都是擦伤硌伤的血印子，尤其还肿了半边脸，还真是狼狈透顶，明明就没什么力气，偏还呈强，看不过去，正待伸手把她拖上山坡去，陡然听得一阵地动山摇般的马蹄声响，如情一瞧，不远处那一支队伍打着“方”字旗号，原来援兵到了，紧接着她又见着知义的身影，心里无比的激动，言语已经不足矣形容她的喜悦，她冲着马队拼命的挥着手，情不自禁的跳起来冲着已经向她奔驰过来的为首一人喊道：“哥哥！哥哥我在这！。”
李骁见她这般喜悦的情形，尤其这一声哥哥，竟是像如情在叫他一般，听进了心里，丝丝纠缠。这时候，他有种错觉，竟是希望自己才是正骑马奔驰过来的知义。
李骁的眼中的眸光沉了又沉后，也仅是缩回了已经伸向如情的那摊开了掌心的手，然后，握紧，落在了身侧。
知义见到如情等人，脸色大变，飞奔下马来，三五下把如情打横抱了起来。如情扑在知义怀里，搂着他的脖子，死活不肯再下地，哭得唏里哗啦。
“哥哥，你总算来了，妹妹还以为永远也见不到哥哥了。”
知义紧紧搂着她，轻轻拍她的背，柔声安慰着，如情又道：“哥哥，我脸好痛，手也痛，脚也痛，头也痛，全身都痛。”
如情见如情肿着半边脸，双唇也肿了起来，脸上还有好些擦伤，出门时还好好的一身衣服，现下已然是弄得不成个样子。
知义心痛不已，忙道：“好好好，为兄立即带你回将军府，好生养伤。”说着便扯了氅子把如情抱在怀里，待知晴上了战马，他才掉转马头，吩咐随着他的兵士，一边下达将令。他一方面调遣先锋营一方面驰援各处隘口，另一方面又命当值的兵士沿途搜检。
如情被知义抱在怀中，紧崩了许久的神经，总算松懈下来，眼皮很是沉重，全身上下只觉麻木的痛，可惜全身湿淋淋的，想睡也不敢睡……古代医疗条件落后，万一感冒了，吃药痛苦不说，万一严重了可就惨了。她很爱惜小命的。
回到将军府，一阵兵慌马乱的忙碌后，知义请来了大夫，给如情上了药，又先熬了碗防治风寒的药，如情吃了药，周妈妈用药酒给她清洗身子，直痛得她杀猪地尖叫着，这个时候，没有碘酒消毒，也没有消炎的药，全用的陈年的高度酒，又消毒又消炎，抹在伤口处，火辣辣的痛，几乎痛到骨子里。

本想求周妈妈放过她，随便擦了就上药的，可周妈妈比老太太还要严厉，一点商量的余地都没有，吩咐几个婆子把如情按在床上，仔细的抹了一遍，如情身上伤口确实多的，擦伤，被石头硌伤，还有好些青紫痕迹，在白嫩的肌肤上，更是触目揪心，周妈妈看得心疼不已，其他婆子被如情这一通震破房子的尖叫，也是很不忍心，纷纷劝说周妈妈，周妈妈也被如情尖叫得头皮发麻，耳朵生鼓。但在绣仕女图屏风后的知义则声音如铁：“不许偷懒，必须先用酒清洗伤口。”
如情痛得眼泪鼻涕狂飙，闻言又忍不住大声求饶：“哥哥，真的好痛呀，呜呜，不要擦了好不好？呜呜……”
知义的声音从屏风后稳稳地传来：“乖，妹妹再忍忍。虽都是些小伤，但稍不注意也成酿成大祸。长痛不如短痛。”
“可是，真的好痛……啊，周妈妈，轻点，轻点……”如情痛得一张脸儿都挤到一起，这么一叫，又扯痛了脸上的伤口，痛得几乎闭过气去。
半个时辰后，周妈妈总算给如情全身清洗了伤口，并上了药，也累得一身的大汗，坐在床沿几乎虚脱了，苦笑，“姑娘从外头回来，力气都比往日大好多。”
如情全身上了药后，虽然伤口仍火辣辣的痛，但比起刚才直接用酒抹好上太多了，闻言忍不住苦笑：“谁说我没力气来着？人家一个人就灭掉了两个靼鞑。”这可是她最厉害的丰功伟绩也。
忽然又想到什么，又问周妈妈：“沉香，玲珑，还有琴儿她们三个也受了好些伤，周妈妈，没有没派人给她们上药？”
“那儿云夫人和雪夫人过去帮衬了。不碍事的，姑娘小心养伤要紧。”
如情一听挽雪也过去了，生怕挽雪疏忽大意，没把伤口清理干净，又道：“还是麻烦周妈妈亲自过去一躺，全用酒水洗一遍伤口这样稳妥些。”
周妈妈失笑，“刚才是谁死活不肯洗伤口的？这会子倒巴不得别人也跟着受罪。”
content_en:
The survival rules of a concubine
In fact, Ruqing also wanted to proudly say that it was her own masterpiece, but this would give people a vicious and vicious impression, and she would not admit it even if she wanted to kill her. This was great, Linglong, this stupid girl, had exposed everything. She couldn't pretend to be weak even if she wanted to. He couldn't help but glared at her in frustration, this girl who failed to accomplish anything but failed more than once.
When Li Xiao's guards heard that it was Ruqing's masterpiece, they all looked at Ruqing with suspicion and fear. Some felt that Ruqing, a weak female prostitute, could actually deal with two ferocious Tatars. Some did not believe it, but some felt that Ruqing was worthy of being Fang Zhiyi's sister. It was true that a tiger brother had no canine sister.
Tiger brother has no canine sister?
When Li Xiao heard this, he almost stopped laughing.
If Ruqing didn't understand the situation, he could only respond with a silly smile, "There's nothing I can do about it, I don't want to do this either. I'll just follow the authority when the situation arises."
Li Xiao smiled and said: "Why do you look like you are afraid that others will know that you are powerful?"
Ruqing felt guilty and had just performed artificial respiration with Li Xiao. The guards on both sides looked at them with warm, ambiguous and complicated looks. She just wanted to leave here quickly and stay far away from Li Xiao.
There was a high and steep slope. Although Li Xiao and others were all injured, it was easy to climb up. However, it was extremely painful. They had already exhausted all their strength, and this time it was very difficult to climb.
Li Xiao also had injuries on his body, but they were minor injuries. People who practice martial arts have long been accustomed to wounds, but seeing Ruqing struggling so hard, he couldn't bear it. He wanted to give her a hand, but Ruqing blocked her, "Thank you, Your Majesty, for your kindness. Ruqing can still walk."
Li Xiao saw that her face, elbows, ankles and whole body were covered with bruises and blood marks, especially half of her face was swollen. She was really embarrassed. She obviously had no strength, but she was still strong. He couldn't see it. Just when he was about to stretch out his hand to drag her up the hillside, he suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves shaking the mountain. He looked at it, and saw the horse's hoofs not far away. A team was holding a banner with the word "square", and it turned out that reinforcements had arrived. Then she saw Zhiyi's figure again, and she was extremely excited. Words were not enough to describe her joy. She waved desperately at the horse team, couldn't help but jump up and shouted to the leader who was already running towards her: "Brother! Brother, I'm here!"
Li Xiao saw her in such a happy state, especially the call "brother", as if he was calling him affectionately, he heard it in his heart and became entangled in it. At this time, he had the illusion that he was actually Zhiyi who was galloping over on horseback.
Li Xiao's eyes darkened again and again, and he simply retracted the hand that had been stretched out to Ruqing, then held it tightly and dropped it to his side.
When Zhiyi saw Ruqing and others, his face changed drastically, he quickly dismounted from his horse, and picked up Ruqing in his arms. Ruqing threw herself into Zhiyi's arms, hugged his neck, refused to go to the ground again, and burst into tears.
"Brother, you are finally here. My sister thought she would never see her brother again."
Zhiyi hugged her tightly, patted her back gently, comforted her softly, and Ruqing said: "Brother, my face hurts, my hands hurt, my feet hurt, my head hurts, my whole body hurts."
Ruqing saw that half of Ruqing's face was swollen, her lips were also swollen, and there were many scratches on her face. She was still wearing good clothes when she went out, but now she was in a mess.
Zhiyi was heartbroken and said hurriedly: "Okay, okay, brother, I will take you back to the general's mansion immediately so that you can recover from your injuries." After saying that, he pulled up his cloak and held Ruqing in his arms. After Zhiqing got on the horse, he turned the horse's head and ordered the soldiers following him, while issuing the general's order. On the one hand, he dispatched the vanguard battalion to rush to various passes, and on the other hand, he ordered the soldiers on duty to inspect along the way.
Ruqing was held in Zhiyi's arms, and her nerves, which had been tense for a long time, finally relaxed. Her eyelids were very heavy, and she felt numb pain all over her body. Unfortunately, her whole body was dripping wet, and she didn't dare to sleep even if she wanted to... Medical conditions in ancient times were backward., if you catch a cold, not to mention the pain of taking medicine, it will be miserable if it becomes serious. She cherishes her life very much.
Back at the General's Mansion, after a flurry of work, Zhiyi invited the doctor to give Ruqing medicine, and then boiled a bowl of medicine to prevent wind and cold. Ruqing took the medicine, and Zhou's mother used medicinal wine to clean her body.
I wanted to beg Mother Zhou to let her go and just rub it on her and apply medicine, but Mother Zhou was even stricter than the old lady and left no room for negotiation. She ordered several women to hold Ruqing down on the bed and wipe it carefully. There were indeed many wounds on Ruqing's body, including scratches, scratches from stones, and... There were many bruises and bruises on the fair and tender skin, which were even more disturbing. Mother Zhou felt distressed when she saw it. The other women couldn't bear it when Ruqing's screams shook the house. They tried to persuade Mother Zhou one after another. Mother Zhou's scalp was numb and her ears were bulging from Ruqing's screams. But Zhiyi, who was embroidering a screen with pictures of ladies, had a voice as strong as iron: "You are not allowed to be lazy. You must clean your wounds with wine first."
Ruqing was so painful that her tears and nose ran wildly. After hearing this, she couldn't help but beg for mercy loudly: "Brother, it really hurts, wuwu, don't wipe it, okay? Wuwu..."
Zhiyi's voice came steadily from behind the screen: "Be good, sister, please bear with me. Although they are minor injuries, if you are not careful, they can lead to catastrophe. Long-term pain is worse than short-term pain."
"But, it really hurts... Ah, Mother Zhou, be gentle, be gentle..." Ruqing was so painful that her face was squeezed together. She screamed like this, and the wound on her face hurt again, and the pain was so painful that she almost stopped breathing.
Half an hour later, Zhou's mother finally cleaned Ruqing's wounds and applied medicine. She was so exhausted that she was sweating profusely. She sat on the edge of the bed and almost collapsed. She smiled bitterly and said, "The girl came back from the outside and is much stronger than before."
After Ruqing applied the medicine all over her body, although the wound was still burning with pain, it was much better than just applying the wine directly. She couldn't help but smile bitterly when she heard this: "Who said I don't have the strength? I killed two Tartars by myself." This was her most powerful achievement.
Suddenly something occurred to her, and she asked Mother Zhou: "Agarwood, Linglong, and Qin'er also suffered many injuries. Mother Zhou, did you send someone to give them medicine?"
"Mrs. Yun and Mrs. Xue have gone over there to help. It's okay. The girl needs to be careful and recover from her injuries."
As soon as Ruqing heard that Wan Xue came over, she was afraid that Wan Xue was careless and didn't clean the wound, so she added: "It would be safer to trouble Mother Zhou to go over and lie down in person and wash the wound with wine."
Mother Zhou laughed, "Who refused to wash the wound just now? Now I wish others would suffer too."
